question: Which part of a decoder stack lets a token take account of the other tokens in the context?

options.feedback: Attention gathers information from the other tokens and moves this token's representation toward its meaning in context.
The MLP works on each token's representation separately, applying learned knowledge. Mixing across tokens is attention's job.
The tokenizer splits text into tokens before the model runs. It does not relate tokens to each other.
Temperature only affects how the next token is sampled at the very end.
